name: Susan Elizabeth Allen
milestones: Married Jeff Weinstein (m. Mar 1991, Santa Barbara, CA)
education: B.F.A. and M.F.A. in Music Performance (harp), California Institute of the Arts
Bachelor of Fine Arts and Master of Fine Arts in Music Performance (Harp) from California Institute of the Arts
career: Harpist; solo performances at Carnegie Recital Hall; specialist in contemporary harp music; many ensemble and solo recordings
On the faculty and staff of California Institute of the Arts from 1978; served as a dean
On the CalArts faculty and staff since 1978; served as Dean of the School of Music

Harpist who has performed worldwide, including solo performances at Carnegie Recital Hall; specializes in contemporary harp music, has made many ensemble and solo recordings, and has taught harp and other stringed instruments
sources: Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams (compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen, Nov 2010)
Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
notes: Child of George Homer Allen and Dorothy Ann Wheeler.
